function.description: Put text into an element by its index: a text field, a text area, a date or picker field, or a rich-text editor. It replaces what the element holds (clear=false adds) and reports what the element holds after. submit=true presses Enter.
function.name: browser_input_text

parameters.description: Model for inputting text into an element.

clear.description: Default true: replace what the element holds. false adds the text at the end

submit.description: true = press Enter after the text
